description: Call this before a consequential action with any tool or connector: sending an email or message, exporting or sharing data, deleting data, writing to production or financial records, payments, or external API writes. ALLOW: proceed. REVIEW: hold the action, tell the user it waits for approval in Vulnify, and check again with get_decision. BLOCK: skip the action and explain the reasons. Records a decision for a proposed action (POST /v1/events). This writes a security event and an audit entry, counts toward the organization quota, and may open a human review. The finalDecision field is the authoritative result. decision is what was stored and does not change when a review is resolved. finalDecision stays REVIEW until a human approves, denies, or the review expires. This tool does not approve the review. A REVIEW or BLOCK finalDecision means the action was not allowed. Optional content is scanned in memory and is not stored. An idempotencyKey makes a retry return the same event.

action.description: Event action. Allowed values: READ_DATA, WRITE_DATA, DELETE_DATA, EXPORT_DATA, SEND_EMAIL.

agent.description: Agent name. Omit only when the API key is bound to an agent. Use this or agentId.

agentId.description: Agent id. Use this or agent.

content.description: Optional text scanned for sensitive data. Scanned in memory by Vulnify and not stored. This server does not log it.

destination.description: Where the data goes. Allowed values: INTERNAL, EXTERNAL_EMAIL, EXTERNAL_API.

idempotencyKey.description: Retries with the same key return the stored decision for 24 hours instead of recording another event.

recordsAffected.description: How many records the action would touch. Optional. 0 to 100000000.

resource.description: Resource name. Use this or resourceId.

resourceId.description: Resource id. Use this or resource.

name: decide_action

finalDecision.description: Authoritative result. Allowed values: ALLOW, REVIEW, BLOCK.

title: Decide action
